summary: Describes three ways for a TURN client to discover TURN servers automatically, instead of relying on explicit configuration. This lets enterprises and ISPs offer their own servers. It updates RFC 5766 to relax the mutual authentication requirement in certain cases.

eli5.summary: When your phone needs a helper to pass messages through a firewall, it used to need the helper's address typed in. Now it can find one on its own.

questions: how to auto discover a turn server
